/start-task Add a --min-length N option to textstats. Keep words whose length is at least N before counting words and frequencies; N is a nonnegative integer, defaults to zero, and negative values are rejected by argparse. Preserve the existing output format and behavior when omitted. Include automated core and CLI tests, using python3 -m unittest discover -s tests. Use standard tier and the branch add-min-length. The user makes every commit. This is an interview only; do not implement.
